gloss: promissory note; bill of exchange; handprint

definitions.gloss: promissory note, bill of exchange, draft
definitions.explanation: A written promise to pay a specified sum of money at a future date, used in business transactions.
An impression or print made by a hand, often used for commemorative purposes or as souvenirs.

notes:
FINANCIAL TERM (sense 1):
{手形|てがた} is a negotiable instrument common in Japanese business, promising payment at a future date.

TYPES OF NOTES:
- ⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧{手形|てがた}: Promissory note
- ⟦{為替|かわせ}→為替：04021_kawase⟧{手形|てがた}: Bill of exchange

KEY EXPRESSIONS:
- {手形|てがた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{出|だ}す→振り出す：19276_furidasu⟧: to issue a note
- {手形|てがた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{割|わ}り{引|び}く→割り引く：29547_waribiku⟧: to discount a note
- {手形|てがた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: note is honored (paid)
- ⟦{不渡|ふわた}り→不渡り：29546_fuwatari⟧{手形|てがた}: Dishonored note

BUSINESS IMPORTANCE:
Two ⟦{不渡|ふわた}り→不渡り：29546_fuwatari⟧ (dishonored notes) within 6 months leads to ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧⟦{停止|ていし}→停止：04067_teishi⟧ (bank transaction suspension), effectively meaning bankruptcy.

HANDPRINT (sense 2):
{手形|てがた} also means a handprint, commonly seen as:
- ⟦{力士|りきし}→力士：10115_rikishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手形|てがた}: Sumo wrestler handprints (popular souvenirs)
- ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手形|てがた}: Baby handprints (keepsakes)

RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{小切手|こぎって}→小切手：06305_kogitte⟧: Check
- ⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧: Cash
- ⟦{振込|ふりこみ}→振込：05421_furikomi⟧: Bank transfer
